bonus: 300 * qualified straight distance / total travel distance; only on three-lap completion; stopped distance never credited.
corner_bonus: 100 * distance-weighted corner smoothness; only on collision-free three-lap completion with no program error. Corner samples require speed >=8 cm/s and yaw rate >=4 deg/s. Quality is the mean of normalized steering-rate and steering-jerk quality; slow/straight travel cannot earn it.
pace_and_distance_bonus_gate: Three-lap completion, zero collisions, zero danger events, zero sharp-steer events, zero unnecessary stops, and no program error. Lap speed bonus is 1 point per second below 600 seconds total. Distance bonus is 100 * clamp((10500 - travel_distance_cm) / 1000, 0, 1).
